title: Reconnection in 2D Inertial Magnetohydrodynamics
summary: We consider two-fluid equations of inertial magnetohydrodynamics in two spatial dimensions. These equations can be recast as the evolution of two active scalars, with fluid-like interaction kernels. The equations come in two flavors, left-handed and right-handed. They are conservative and have global unique solutions for both smooth initial data and for initial data in Yudovich class $L^1(\mathbb R^2)\cap L^{\infty}(\mathbb R^2)$.
